Qal Imperfect 3 feminine singular תַּעֲרֹג Ps 42:2 (of stag, with עַל of thing in simile); with אֶל, of longing for God vPs 42:2 (subject נַפְשִׁי), so תַּעֲרוֺג Joel 1:20 (of beasts, craving water).
